transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Minibuses to Sharm El Sheikh usually leave when full; the fare is agreed with the driver in advance. Car rental is available: Hertz, Thrifty and local companies.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: Taxis are available at the airport; the fare is agreed with the driver before boarding.

terminals.title: Terminals
terminals.text: The airport has two passenger terminals. There are ATMs and currency exchange points.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: The airport has a left luggage office. Sources do not state the price.
